title: Venue ready: pitch and ground prepared for the series opener
excerpt: Groundstaff finish final preparations as the venue opens its gates for the first match.
body: The pitch square was rolled for the last time on Tuesday evening, with the creases painted and the covers wheeled to the boundary. The outfield has been cut to match-day length and the floodlights passed their final test.
Teams arrive later this week for practice sessions. Gates open two hours before the first ball, and organisers expect a full house for the opener under lights.
quote: Everything is in place. Now it is over to the players.
author: Sports Desk
